name: Alpaca Market Data
tagline: Real-time US equity quotes, charts and options chains from Alpaca's free IEX feed
description: Serves US-listed equities and ETFs from Alpaca Market Data ahead of Gloom Cloud: real-time IEX quotes and streaming trades, intraday and daily bars at every chart resolution, and options chains from the indicative options feed. Fundamentals, filings, news, FX and non-US listings keep coming from Gloom Cloud. Needs a free Alpaca account's API key pair.
